title: Final Position Minimum
description: Essential Criteria: The position of the n-th minimum for the apodized slit must be correctly calculated as sin theta = lambda/(2b)(2n + 1).

title: Unapodized Minimum
description: Essential Criteria: The position of the n-th minimum for the unapodized slit must be correctly stated as sin theta' = n lambda/b.

title: Intensity Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The intensity at the midpoint between the (n-1)-th and n-th minima must be derived correctly.

title: Normalization of Intensity
description: Important Criteria: The normalization of intensity results to the first maximum must be accurately performed for both apodized and unapodized cases.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Missing the correct factors or signs in the final expressions for intensity or positions will lead to significant errors.
